tool_reviews.name: CCC (Claude Command Center)
tool_reviews.price: Free: USD 0, with no tiers, no paid plan, no seat count and no account for the local app. Licensed FSL-1.1-MIT (copyright 2026 Amir Fish), which is source-available rather than OSI open source: you may use, copy, modify and redistribute it for any Permitted Purpose, a Competing Use is barred, and each version converts to the MIT license on its second anniversary. Downloads are a 3.6 MB notarized and Apple-signed DMG, a Homebrew tap (amirfish1/tap/ccc), a curl installer for macOS/Linux and a PowerShell installer for Windows. The optional CCC Cloud phone relay is account-based; no price appears for it on any fetched page either. No page on the site carries a price token other than $0.

tool_reviews.price: One-time credit packs, no subscription: 10 credits USD 2.99, 30 credits USD 6.99 and 100 credits USD 14.99, each card showing a struck-through list price of USD 4.99 / 9.99 / 24.99. tool_reviews.name: Genjutsu AI
tool_reviews.price: Free tier: 18 one-time signup credits, watermarked previews and downloads, roughly 3 images or 1 short clip, plus a weekly check-in worth up to 60 credits across the reward cycle. Subscriptions billed monthly: Starter $29.9 for 800 credits/month, Pro $49.9 for 1,800, Business $99.9 for 4,000. Billed yearly (the price printed on the card): Starter $100.0 a year, shown as $8.3/month, 2,400 credits/year; Pro $360.0 a year, shown as $30.0/month against a struck-through $49.9, 21,600 credits/year; Business $599.0 a year, shown as $49.9/month against a struck-through $99.9, 48,000 credits/year. One-time packs under the Pay once tab, credits never expire: Flex $99 for 2,000 credits, Starter Pack $199.9 for 4,900, Pro Pack $499.9 for 19,900. Subscription credits expire each period; card prices are USD before tax. Refund requests within 72 hours, calculated pro rata on unused purchased credits minus actual non-returned processing fees capped at 6% of the order. Read on 2026-10-26 from the rendered /pricing page on all three tabs; the plan figures are not literals in the served HTML, so they were captured from the rendered page rather than a price-token sweep.

tool_reviews.name: RapVideo AI
tool_reviews.price: Free preview: some new accounts are offered one short low-resolution preview at the vendor's discretion (no card, no trial on paid plans). Monthly plans, credits reset each month and unused credits expire: Basic $29.90/mo (100 credits, shown on the card as 8 videos), Pro $49.90/mo (200 credits, 16 videos), Agency $99.90/mo (480 credits, 40 videos). Yearly plans renew automatically and are badged 'up to 44% off', but only the Basic yearly figure is in the served HTML ($299/yr for 120 videos, about 17% below monthly); Pro and Agency yearly prices need JavaScript. One-time packs, credits never expire: Single $9.99 (12 credits, 1 video), Trio $19.99 (36 credits, 3 videos), Crew $49 (120 credits, 10 videos), Studio $99 (300 credits, 25 videos), Label $199 (720 credits, 60 videos). A standard 12-second 720p render costs 10 credits; faster Seedance 2.0 tiers cost 8-20 and Seedance 2.5 Ultra up to 93 at 1080p. Failed, timed-out or safety-blocked renders are refunded automatically. USD, charged by Stripe.

tool_reviews.name: CustomGPT.ai
tool_reviews.price: Standard $99/month or $89/month billed annually (10 agents, 1,000 queries/month, 5,000 documents per agent, 60 million words, 3 seats). Premium $499/month or $449/month billed annually (25 agents, 5,000 queries/month, 20,000 documents per agent, 300 million words, 5 seats, auto-sync, branding removal). Enterprise custom. Every published plan starts with a 7-day trial that requires a credit card and then charges the selected plan. Checked 2026-10-27.

tool_reviews.name: UMEVO
tool_reviews.price: Hardware, one-time purchase in USD from UMEVO's own Shopify store: Note $79 (64GB), Note Plus $109 on sale against a $169 list price (badged '35% off' on a Fall Sale banner whose countdown renders 00:00:00 and states no end date), Note ONE $159 on sale against $179, magnetic case $20, 3-in-1 accessory kit $20, plus a $5 shipping line item. AI minutes depend on which model you buy. Note Plus: Max plan free for year one (unlimited transcription under fair-use terms), then the free Starter plan at 400 transcription minutes a month; from year two that page offers 'Pro $2.50/mo or Max $5.83/mo, billed annually' and minute packs of 120/600/3,000/6,000 minutes at $0.59/$2.59/$10.99/$19.99. Note ONE: 30,000 transcription minutes a month for the first 3 months after activation, then free Starter at 400/month, with Pro $7.99/mo or $69.99/yr (1,800 min/mo), MAX $19.99/mo or $149.99/yr (unlimited) and packs of 120/600/3,000/6,000 minutes at $2.49/$9.49/$44.99/$79.99. The two product pages' ladders do not agree with each other. Minute packs are valid for 2 years; plan minutes reset monthly and free minutes do not carry over. Note ($79) includes no AI plan at all - recording works, transcription follows the companion app's free Starter tier or a paid upgrade. Language count is plan-gated on the Note ONE table: 114 languages on Starter and Pro, 140+ on MAX.

Model rates are published per second, per image, per request or per 1M tokens - Seedance 2.5 runs from $0.055/second at 480p to $0.702/second at 1080p across nine providers, GPT Image 2.6 Flare from $0.016/image, GPT-6 Astra $2.66/1M input tokens. Signup grants starter credits; the homepage FAQ also promises a daily check-in bonus that the site's own public config reports as disabled. USD, no card for the free tier. Verified 2026-11-13.

tool_reviews.name: Random Topic Generator
tool_reviews.price: Free $0: unlimited topic draws (1, 3 or 5 at a time from a 250-topic library in English, Chinese, French, Indonesian, Arabic, Turkish, Thai and Hindi), the 1/2/3/5-minute timer and local recording, with no account and no credits; free accounts cannot request the AI report. Standard $19.9 a month for 2,000 credits a month; Pro $59.9 a month for 6,000 credits a month (the page calls it 3x the monthly credits), both 'valid for the current month; cancel anytime'. One-time packs, 'one-time payment, no auto-renewal': $5.00 for 500 credits, $10.00 for 1,000, $20.00 for 2,000. AI analysis is 100 credits a run, so a $5 pack is about 5 analyses, $10 about 10 (the card itself says 'Up to 10 AI analyses (100 credits each)'), Standard about 20 a month and Pro about 60 - roughly $1 an analysis on every path. Paid by card through Stripe; the plan prices, credit allowances and Stripe price keys also appear in the shipped app bundle. USD. Verified 2026-11-14.

tool_reviews.name: RapVideoGo
tool_reviews.price: One-time credit packs only, no subscription and no auto-renewal, credits never expire (the pricing bundle carries creditsValidDays: 0): Single $6.99 (10 credits), Duo Pack $29 (50), Crew Pack $99 (200), Studio Pack $199 (450), Label Pack $599 (1,500). The same five figures and the same 17% / 29% / 37% / 43% savings badges appear on /zh/pricing, and the pack SKUs in the shipped pricing chunk (rap_single 699c/10cr, rap_duo 2900c/50, rap_crew 9900c/200, rap_studio 19900c/450, rap_label 59900c/1500) agree with the cards. USD, charged through the site's own checkout after sign-in; /api/config/public returns waffo_enabled:true plus Google sign-in, email verification and password reset all enabled.

tool_reviews.name: PawGroove
tool_reviews.price: One-time credit packs only, no subscription and no auto-renewal, priced in USD: Starter $4.99 for 50 credits and Creator $9.99 for 120 credits, printed as $1.00 and $0.83 per 10 credits respectively. A dog video costs 10 credits, a full themed photo pack of 6-8 images costs 20, a 2-image preview costs 10, and extra image redos cost 3 credits each after two free redos per full pack. Eligible new accounts can receive 10 welcome credits for one video or a 2-image preview, not both, subject to network limits and a daily grant cap; trial videos are 480p and accounts with an eligible paid order get 720p for new videos. The same two pack prices, the same credit costs and the same per-10-credit figures appear on /pricing, on /zh/pricing and in the Terms, and the 50-credit and 120-credit pack arithmetic reconciles in the Terms' own examples ('50 credits can make two full photo packs and one video', '120 credits can make six full photo packs'). The live pricing page renders 'Buy Starter' and 'Buy Creator' buttons after its 'Checking payment availability...' placeholder resolves, and /api/config/public returns default_payment_provider:stripe, stripe_enabled:true and stripe_environment:live. No purchase was attempted.

tool_reviews.name: PawMambo
tool_reviews.price: One-time credit packs only, no subscription and no auto-renewal, priced in USD: Try $6.99 for 60 credits (30 seconds of video), Make more $14.90 for 160 credits (80 seconds) and Keep creating $29.90 for 340 credits (170 seconds). The stated rate is 2 credits per second of finished video with a 10-credit minimum per request, so a 10-second clip is 20 credits, the built-in 16-second Denim Shuffle is 32 and a 30-second custom reference is 60; at those rates a 10-second video works out at $2.33 on the smallest pack and $1.76 on the largest. New accounts get 20 welcome credits once - enough for one 10-second video - and the page warns that a 16-second Denim Shuffle costs 32 credits, so the welcome grant does not cover it. Purchased credits do not expire. The pack arithmetic reconciles with the stated rate on every row (60 credits / 2 per second = 30 seconds, 160 = 80, 340 = 170), and the pricing page states the same figures in its FAQ answers. Stripe handles payment; no purchase was attempted.

tool_reviews.name: Savingy
tool_reviews.price: Free core with no card and no time limit: unlimited manual income and expense records, one-line entry, receipts, statement import, the tracker and money screens, monthly budgets and plans, goals and contributions, bill reminders, the Weekly Reset review, Ask Savingy, recurring purchases, calculators, and data backup/restore/export. Pro is sold as fixed access periods in INR, one payment each: Rs 149 for 30 days, or Rs 1,188 for 365 days - printed as about Rs 99 a month paid once, saving Rs 600 against twelve 30-day periods (12 x 149 = 1,788). No automatic renewal: the pricing FAQ answers 'Does Pro renew automatically? No. You pay once for 30 or 365 days. When the period ends, Pro stops and everything you logged stays on Free.' A one-time 45-day Pro trial opens after 30 real expense or income entries, at the user's choosing, with no card and no charge when it ends. Razorpay takes the payment; the shipped checkout bundle hardcodes the same amounts (monthly 149, yearly 1188) and loads checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js. The Google Play listing prints the identical offer: 'Rs 149 for 30 days or Rs 1,188 for a year. Fixed access periods: no subscription and no automatic renewal.' All prices include GST per the store listing. No purchase was attempted.

tool_reviews.name: Reply Argus
tool_reviews.price: No self-serve free plan is published on /pricing, which sells three monthly-or-yearly plans and Enterprise: Indie $9.99/mo or $99.90/yr ($8.33/mo billed annually) with 4 active apps and 300 replies/mo; Pro $19.99/mo or $199.90/yr ($16.66/mo) with 10 active apps and 2,000 replies, adding automation rules, auto-translate, analytics, the public REST API and signed webhooks; Studio $99/mo or $990/yr ($82.50/mo) with 30 active apps and 8,000 replies, white-label sending domain and per-app isolation; Enterprise custom. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial and the card is required at signup: the pricing FAQ answers 'You add a card to begin, but nothing is charged until day 14'. Seats are included rather than sold (5 / 10 / 25 / unlimited) and viewers are free; the FAQ states 'You're never billed for overage'. Yearly billing is exactly ten months of the monthly price (2 months free), so 9.99x10 = 99.90, 19.99x10 = 199.90 and 99x10 = 990 all reconcile. The same three prices appear in /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt and the pricing page's JSON-LD Offer array. Two add-ons are described in the Terms (extra active-app slots billed on the regular cycle, and prepaid reply top-up packs that do not expire) but neither carries a price on /pricing. The vendor contradicts this on its own signup and login pages, which read 'Free for 1 app and 100 replies a month. You don't need a card', and the pricing FAQ answers 'Is there a free plan? No'. No purchase or trial was started; billing is by Dodo Payments as merchant of record.
